subject: [video] WP05 real path now correctly fails on non-clean ffmpeg decode; evidence for WP03
body: WP05's real-encoder test now requires ffmpeg stderr to be empty, not just a 10-picture raw size. Forced run: IDR decodes cleanly, every P slice adds CAVLC errors (mb_skip_run/total_coeff/cbp), so WP03's intra path is good and the P path is still corrupt. Reported to WP03 with the h264 path and the exact stderr. The committed default suite remains green (736/736) because the real run is gated on avc/STATUS.json/WP05_REAL; no WP05 defect is implied. I will rerun the moment WP03 announces.
